BiblicalUsage: Cheqeq is a decree, a resolution set down by those in power, and it carries a warning wherever it appears. Isaiah pronounces woe on rulers who decree unrighteous decrees, and in Deborah's song the tribes are divided by great searchings of heart over whether to come to the battle.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a decree is only as good as the heart behind it, and unjust laws are no laws at all before God.
